response.sql: WITH overall AS (SELECT AVG(GOT) AS overall_got FROM Laboratory HAVING COUNT(GOT) > 0), patient_averages AS (SELECT ID, AVG(GOT) AS avg_got, AVG(RBC) AS avg_rbc FROM Laboratory GROUP BY ID) SELECT p.ID, p.avg_got, p.avg_rbc, p.avg_got - o.overall_got AS got_difference FROM patient_averages AS p CROSS JOIN overall AS o ORDER BY got_difference IS NULL, got_difference DESC LIMIT 10;
